title: Malicious code in @xz-bails/baileys (npm)
description: The npm package @xz-bails/baileys versions 6.0.10 and 6.0.11 include a dependency on libsignal sourced directly from a personal GitHub repository without a fixed commit or integrity check. This allows the repository owner to execute arbitrary code during package installation, posing a risk of malicious code execution on the installer's machine.
